basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Raipur (NIT Raipur) Research Associate (RA) Notification 2026 has been released on the official website https://www.nitrr.ac.in. A total of 1 Research Associate (RA) vacancy has been announced through the NIT Raipur Research Associate (RA) Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years Age relaxation will be as per government rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. degree in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology Engineering/Artificial Intelligence/other relevant field (with specialization relevant to the project) from a recognized institute/university, ME/MTech in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology Engineering/Artificial Intelligence/other relevant field with 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience and at least two SCI/SCIE research papers
qualification.details: Ph.D. degree in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology Engineering/Artificial Intelligence/other relevant field (with specialization relevant to the project) from a recognized institute/university. OR ME/MTech in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology Engineering/Artificial Intelligence/other relevant field with 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience and at least two SCI/SCIE research papers.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Raipur Research Associate (RA) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: .
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 02-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Raipur Research Associate (RA) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the NIT Raipur Research Associate (RA) recruitment is 02-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 58,000/- Per Month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate (RA) post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Associate (RA) position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D. degree or an ME/MTech with 3 years of relevant experience and research publications.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Research Associate (RA) role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test for shortlisting, followed by a presentation and interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at National Institute of Technology Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate (RA) post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is contractual.
